items.html: And remember, do not forget, that every inner light enters first, and afterwards, from its power, the light sparkles and goes out in the secret of surrounding. And so the first inner one preceded the first surrounding one; and after the first surrounding one, the second inner one is made; and afterwards the surrounding one of it is made; and afterwards the third inner one; and afterwards the third surrounding one, which is the secret of the Tefillin, as we shall explain below, G-d willing.
